title: Tower-flora foundational growth architecture
scope: Foundational growth architecture of the K2 tower-flora kingdom at qualitative strategy grain. Species, dimensions, chemistry, anatomy, reproduction mechanisms, kingdom assignments of named vegetation, human uses, Mana patterns, and local presence remain open.
approval_evidence: After the A/B/C architecture cards were presented with A recommended, the Author selected 'A — Core-and-casing' on 2026-08-17.
question: What foundational growth architecture should define the K2 tower-flora kingdom?
selection: Core-and-casing towers: individual non-networked organisms growing from a single persistent living core column that lays down successive external structural casing layers which die in place, so mature towers are living columns sheathed in dead self-supporting casings. Deep-seated life makes surface damage survivable while core breach is the mortal wound. Towers are long-lived and slow to replace, seasonal growth is strongly pulsed, and reproduction concentrates in episodic heavy seeding years.
alternatives: K2-ARCH-A: living core with dead external casings, inverted from Earth trees; selected.
K2-ARCH-B: stacked semi-independent modules with regrowable tops; not selected (blurs K1's modular identity).
K2-ARCH-C: fused multi-strand braided trunks with partial-death states; not selected (permanent descriptive complexity).
rationale: The living-core/dead-casing inversion is alien but instantly legible, preserves the sharpest contrast with K1's networked modularity, and seeds boundable story hooks — survivable scorching, mortal core wounds, possible kill-free casing harvest, masting pulses — without retcon pressure on any existing record.
consequences: The K2 kingdom's members are individual non-networked organisms with living cores and dead external casings.
Surface and fire damage are survivable in principle while core breach is the characteristic mortal wound.
Mature towers are finite landscape capital with slow replacement.
Reproduction concentrates in episodic heavy seeding years for later food-web development.
Woodland, rainforest-candidate, and timber-analogue development must build on this architecture.
No Earth-tree homology, human practice, guaranteed harvest, or System mechanic is created.
residual_unknowns: Species, branch structure, dimensions, lifespan, and silhouettes beyond the core-and-casing theme remain open.
Core and casing anatomy, chemistry, material properties, decay, and any harvestability remain open.
Energy capture, leaf-analogues, root form, and water handling remain open.
Seeding mechanisms, structures, dispersal, periods, synchrony, and triggers remain open.
Kingdom assignments of the western rainforest and basin woodland remain open.
Pests, diseases, symbioses including any K6 partnership, and Mana patterns remain open.
Human uses, practices, and knowledge remain open.
reopening_conditions: The architecture cannot support required woodland ecology or material culture.
A concrete contradiction with an accepted or provisional record emerges.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
